work_item.title: Prevent complete command retention
scope: Correct the WI-0029 Quality NO-GO by ensuring durable command records and Dashboard history never retain or reconstruct the complete instruction, including ordinary one-character and short instructions.

Preserve transient pre-send confirmation and exact provider delivery after explicit confirmation; do not execute a real Codex task, add remote control, push, release, publish, or expand command scope.
acceptance_criteria: Durable commands.json records contain no complete raw normalized instruction for one-character, short, long, or secret-bearing inputs; history uses a non-content privacy-safe summary.
Focused tests prove transient confirmation still shows the exact pending instruction, the provider receives it exactly once after confirmation, and durable/history state cannot reproduce it.
Fresh focused, full, schema, Doctor, and local Dashboard runtime verification pass on an exact candidate revision without mutating a real Codex task.
